description: Recent events on one Shield site at or above a risk score, newest first: event name, page, IP, country, network, network signals, score, recommendation and reasons. Good for questions like "what risky traffic hit my signup form this week". End-user identity is never returned.

event_name.description: Only this event, for example signup_attempt, login_attempt or payment_attempt

min_risk_score.description: Lowest risk score to include. Default 50 (high and critical)

site.description: Site ID, name or domain, as shown by list_shield_sites

name: recent_risky_events
title: Recent risky events
